name: Commander Zero
effect:

effect:

Reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "ZEZTZ" family Spirit card with a name different to this Spirit's to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

effect:

name: CODE Zeroider
effect:
[LV1-2] [Your Main Step]
If you control any exhausted "ZEZTZ" family Spirit, this Nexus gains an extra Purple symbol.

[LV2] <True Release> [Either Attack Step] [Can't Stack • Once Per Turn]
When your "ZEZTZ" family Spirits are destroyed, you can target an opposing Spirit. Send a core, besides Soul Core, from it to the Reserve.

name: Capsem Dropper
effect:

All your attacking "ZEZTZ" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.

[LV2] [Start of Your Main Step]
If your Hand is four or less, and you control any exhausted "ZEZTZ" family Spirit, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's a "ZEZTZ" family Spirit card, add it to the Hand. Return any remaining card to the deckbottom.

name: Catastrom Crusher
effect:

name: Breakam Slash

If you control any Purple symbol, you can use it with just the Stan Soul Core.

[Flash]
Target one of your "ZEZTZ" family Spirits. During this battle, give it +3000 BP. Then, if it has [Form Change], draw a card.
